principle: Run/Trace identity fields are named FROM the existing authority vocabulary, never invented and never normalised. The four state vocabularies stay separate; the sweep concept-token overlap stays surfaced; the DISPLACEMENT exact-name collision is disambiguated by vocabulary prefix, not merged.

state_vocabularies.name: smc_choch
state_vocabularies.note: Pure signed operation (BOS x trend_bias) over registered features, domain {-1,0,+1}. NOT a state machine; ontology explicitly excludes BOS/CHOCH detection machines (market_ontology.yaml:32).

crt_to_predicate_gating_edge.description: Each crt_machine state's activation_condition is a conjunction of feature_enum GATES (each expecting an enum value such as NoSweep/NoBreak/NoHigherHigh). This is the ONLY place the two vocabularies formally meet, and therefore the exact surface a Run/Trace can_join field must encode.

exact_name_collisions.resolution: prefix-disambiguate, do not merge: crt::DISPLACEMENT (state) vs feature_enum::displacement_flag (enum gate).

trace_id.purpose: Identifies a contiguous CRT-machine residence episode. Composite of crt_machine canonical state + the gating predicate fingerprint that admitted it.
trace_id.value_domain: crt_machine canonical state (one of the 12) + feature_enum gate fingerprint

can_join.purpose: Predicate-level joinability test: whether the observed feature_enum gate values satisfy the target CRT state's activation_condition.
can_join.value_domain: bitmask / predicate over the 10 gate keys (liquidity_sweep, break_of_structure, sweep_detected, displacement_flag, double_sweep, higher_high, lower_low, retest_flag, swing_high, swing_low)

llm_pending_alignments: S7: of the 47 features_with_no_state, which are genuine API gaps (need a feature_enum state parent) vs legitimate scalar measurements (e.g. atr, volume_ratio) — semantic determination, not census-derivable.

S6/shape: whether shape-layer members of concept families (DoubleSweepTrap, BuySideSweep, SellSideSweep) are aliases of one geometric intent or distinct shapes — cross-check against docs/research-readiness/ic-003-shape-narratives.md.
Confirm the sweep 6-way overlap stays un-collapsed (same market concept, distinct computational vocabularies).
downstream_application: Consumed by the Run/Trace identity design (layer_trace/* engine) to name trace_id / can_join per the census vocabularies. Engine implementation is OUT of scope for this schema artifact.
